actions.action: Reserve critical capacity before accepting ordinary events.
actions.mechanism: Separate capacity budgets prevent ordinary traffic from consuming space required by the bounded critical history.
actions.implementation: Preallocate critical, ordinary, and metadata regions totaling 20 MB. Size critical storage for 2 MB plus bounded encoding overhead; allowlist diagnostic fields.
actions.check: Inject maximum ordinary traffic and 2 MB of critical events over 30 minutes; verify every critical sequence survives within quota.
actions.risk: An unverified encoding-overhead bound invalidates the reservation.

actions.action: Replace excess ordinary detail with explicit summaries.
actions.mechanism: Fixed time buckets preserve evidence of reduction without retaining every ordinary event.
actions.implementation: Allocate bounded bucket metadata containing interval, observed count, retained count, and reduction mode. Evict only ordinary detail; never record content-derived values.
actions.check: Overrun ordinary storage throughout a 30-minute outage; verify each reduced interval is marked and counts reconcile with generated events.
actions.risk: Coarse buckets identify reduced intervals, not individual omitted events.

actions.action: Make replay identities stable across retries.
actions.mechanism: Persistent record identities distinguish duplicated transmissions from absent events; summaries explain intentional ordinary-detail reduction.
actions.implementation: Assign stream epoch and sequence before reduction. Upload stable batch manifests with retained ranges and summaries; deduplicate at the collector and reclaim only acknowledged records.
actions.check: Drop acknowledgments, resend batches, and deliberately omit a critical record; verify duplicates collapse while the missing critical sequence is reported.
actions.risk: Epoch reuse or premature acknowledgment-based reclamation can conceal loss.

actions.action: Recover committed critical records after interrupted writes.
actions.mechanism: An append-only journal with checksums and commit markers makes persisted records recoverable without destructive verification.
actions.implementation: Use preallocated journal space, bounded framing, and durability barriers. Scan on startup, reject incomplete tails, and replay committed records without clearing them before acknowledgment.
actions.check: Interrupt writes and acknowledgment handling at each boundary; restart and replay. Verify every durably accepted critical sequence appears and duplicates remain identifiable.
actions.risk: Storage failure remains outside this protection; synchronous durability may increase latency.
